svg.title: Morph architecture
svg.desc: Teacher causal LM with N blocks; the block list is located via known attribute paths; k blocks are selected uniformly across depth; a reduced student copies embeddings, norms, LM head and the selected blocks. Either save directly (compress-only) or distill with cross-entropy, temperature-scaled KL and optional hidden-state MSE against a frozen, optionally 4/8-bit quantized teacher. Output is a standard Transformers checkpoint plus compression metadata.
svg.text: distill() · frozen teacher + trainable student on packed sequences
Depth only: width, heads and vocabulary are unchanged. Quality must be measured on held-out data, not inferred from the ratio.
